title: Pilot Trial on the Clinical Characterization of a Cytokine-Eliminating Hemodialysis Membrane
summary: An Patienten mit Infektionen und Nierenversagen, die eine Dialyse (Blutwäsche) benötigen, wird eine Hämodialysebehandlung mit einer neuartigen Dialysemembran, die insbesondere auch Entzündungseiweiße entfernen kann, durchgeführt. Die Leistung der Dialysemembran wird dabei anhand von Messungen bestimmter Laborwerte ermittelt.
conditions: acute renal failure; end-stage kidney disease; infection

interventions.name: Hemodialysis with a cytokine-eliminating hemodialysis membrane

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Requiring hemodialysis for renal replacement therapy; end-stage oder acute renal failure requiring dialysis; current acute bacterial oder viral infection, such as pneumonia, urinary tract infection etc.; presence of blood access for routine hemodialysis (AV fistula or catheter); ability to give consent for participation in the study; presence of the patient's written informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
Women being pregnant or breast feeding; risk of bleeding resulting from comorbidity or recent surgery; known allergy to components of the extracorporeal therapy; existence of contraindications for the administration of heparin for anticoagulation including heparin-induced thrombocytopenia type II; existence of morbidities with assumed life expectancy below 6 months; circulatory instability.
